summary.name: Moony
summary.one_liner: Moony is a free, open-source desktop personal finance app for tracking bank accounts, investments, crypto, property, insurance and loans in an encrypted local database.
use_cases: Track account balances and debts in one overview
Import bank statements and categorise transactions
Follow stock, ETF and crypto portfolio returns
Track property values, rent and insurance payments
Monitor loan repayments and outstanding debt
Keep financial data offline and private on your own computer
summary.what_it_does: Moony is a desktop app that consolidates account balances, investments, property, insurance and loans into one overview of assets and debts. It imports bank statements in CSV (with column detection), CAMT.053, MT940, OFX/QFX and QIF formats, skips duplicate transactions, lets you categorise transactions with rules, and allows undoing an import. Investment tracking covers stocks, ETFs and crypto with returns, dividends and imports from XTB, Trading 212, Degiro and IBKR, using online price data. Records and attachments are encrypted on the local computer, and an optional MCP integration lets an AI agent access your data.
notable: Free and open source, no sign-up, no telemetry or analytics
Encrypted local database with recovery key and password reset
Imports statements in CSV, CAMT.053, MT940, OFX/QFX and QIF
Optional MCP integration for AI agents, off by default
caveats: Direct bank connections are not available yet; statements must be imported manually
Exported files and saved copies are unencrypted
Windows may show a security warning on first launch because the installer is not signed
